focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Related Work 批判分类与 Methodology 机制阐述（BP09–BP16）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 问题形式化定义与符号约定段（Problem Formulation & Notation）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 Methodology 开篇（Section 3.1 Problem Formulation），严谨、简洁地定义输入张量、输出目标、约束条件与优化目标。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Methodology 第 3.1 节 Problem Formulation
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [任务总体形式化 Task Definition]：Consider a [System/Dataset] observed over a lookback window of length $L$, denoted as $\mathbf{X} = [x_1, \dots, x_L] \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$, where $C$ represents [Meaning].
S2 [补充条件或模态输入 Auxiliary/Condition Inputs]：At each step $t$, the system also receives [Condition/Observation] $z_t \in \mathcal{Z}$ under [Noise/Missingness/Dynamic Regime].

S3 [预测/控制目标 Objective]：Our goal is to learn a parameterized mapping $f_\theta(\cdot)$ that predicts future states $\hat{\mathbf{Y}} \in \mathbb{R}^{H \times C}$ over horizon $H$ (or action trajectory $a_{t:t+K}$).
S4 [核心分布/物理约束 Core Constraint]：Crucially, unlike standard stationary settings where $P(\mathbf{X})$ remains fixed, we address the regime where [Mathematical Constraint/Shift] varies across time.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Input Space -> Auxiliary Conditions -> Target Mapping -> Crucial Distributional Constraint. 绑定逻辑规则：L014, L011.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In this section, we define the problem. The input is X. X has length L and C channels. The output is Y. Y has length H. We want to make the error between predicted Y and true Y as small as possible.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 全是碎片化的幼稚简单句（The input is X. X has...），缺乏数学严谨性与核心科学问题界定。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Consider a multivariate time series $\mathbf{X}_{1:L} = [x_1, \dots, x_L]^\top \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$ recording $C$ correlated sensors over lookback horizon $L$. Given an binary observation mask $\mathbf{M} \in \{0, 1\}^{L \times C}$ indicating irregular sensor dropouts, our objective is to learn a generative mapping $p_\theta(\mathbf{Y}_{L+1:L+H} \mid \mathbf{X}_{1:L} \odot \mathbf{M})$ over future horizon $H$. Crucially, unlike standard settings that assume time-invariant marginal distributions, we explicitly account for non-stationary regime shifts where $\mathbb{E}[x_t]$ and $\text{Cov}(x_t)$ evolve continuously between the lookback and forecasting windows.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Experiments 主结果、消融归因与 Limitations 讨论（BP17–BP24）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 局限性（Limitations）客观陈述与未来扩展段（Constructive Limitations）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写论文末尾或 NeurIPS/ICLR Checklist 要求的 Limitations 段落：诚实指出当前方法的两个客观边界，但绝不贬损论文的核心贡献。
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [边界 1：极端高维或极度稀疏场景 Boundary 1]：Despite its effectiveness across standard benchmarks, our framework currently exhibits two practical boundaries.

S2 [边界 1 机理分析与解法 Mechanism & Solution 1]：First, when the variate dimension scales beyond $C > 5,000$ unclustered sensors, constructing the cross-channel phase graph incurs noticeable memory overhead; integrating hierarchical sensor clustering offers a natural remedy.
S3 [边界 2：特定假设限制 Boundary 2]：Second, our continuous scale tracker assumes piece-wise differentiable drift and may under-estimate instantaneous discontinuous jumps caused by hardware resets.
S4 [未来演进方向 Future Extension]：Coupling our neural ODE tracker with jump-diffusion stochastic processes represents a promising avenue for future work.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Two Objective Boundaries -> [Boundary 1 + Technical Remedy] -> [Boundary 2 + Stochastic Extension]. 绑定逻辑规则：L017.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Our paper has some limitations. We did not test on very big datasets because we do not have enough GPUs. In the future, we will try more datasets and make the model better.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 写成了“因为没卡所以没做完实验”的借口，不仅毫无学术价值，反而会诱发审稿人拒稿。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Despite its strong empirical performance, our framework exhibits two theoretical boundaries worth noting. First, while our spectral branch scales quasi-linearly with sequence length, computing pairwise Hilbert phase differences scales quadratically with channel count ($O(C^2)$), which increases memory footprint when $C > 2,000$; incorporating anchor-based low-rank graph sparsification provides a direct remedy. Second, our continuous neural-ODE scale tracker assumes piece-wise smooth drift and may smooth over instantaneous step discontinuities caused by sensor recalibration. Extending the continuous drift prior to jump-diffusion stochastic differential equations offers a principled direction for future investigation.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 让步-反驳段：优雅承认反方合理成分并强力扭转权重（Concession & Refutation）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文中回应反方观点（Some people argue that...）：先大度承认反方担忧在短期或局部确实存在，再用结构性证据或制度设计证明该问题完全可控，从而锁死我方立场。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 让步反驳段（Body Paragraph 2 or 3）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [呈现反方最有力的担忧 Articulate Opposing Concern]：Admittedly, critics raise a valid concern that [Opposing Argument, e.g., automation displaces entry-level clerical and manufacturing workers].
S2 [承认局部真实性 Acknowledge Partial Validity]：In the short term, rapid deployment of [Technology/Policy] can indeed create transitional friction for workers whose routines are easily codified.
S3 [釜底抽薪式转折 Structural Pivot]：However, viewing [X] purely as a zero-sum threat overlooks how productivity gains generate entirely new categories of skilled employment.

S4 [历史/现实反证与制度补救 Evidence & Mitigation]：Just as spreadsheet software reduced manual bookkeeping while expanding demand for financial analysts, pairing automation with targeted vocational retraining allows displaced workers to transition into system supervision and maintenance roles.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Admittedly (Valid Concern) -> Short-term Reality -> However (Zero-Sum Fallacy Pivot) -> Historical Analogy & Policy Mitigation. 绑定逻辑规则：L008, L023.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Some people think robots will take all our jobs and make everyone poor. This is wrong. Robots will create new jobs, and people can learn new skills to find better jobs easily.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 生硬武断（This is wrong, find better jobs easily），既没有共情反方的合理短期阵痛，也没有给出可信的历史类比或转型机制。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Admittedly, critics raise a legitimate concern that autonomous robotics and generative software can displace routine clerical and assembly-line workers. During initial transition phases, rapid automation does create localized employment friction for personnel whose tasks follow rigid, codifiable rules. However, treating technological upgrading as a fixed-pie zero-sum game overlooks how productivity gains expand downstream service and engineering roles. Much as spreadsheet software eliminated manual ledger keeping while multiplying demand for financial data analysts, coupling industrial automation with subsidized reskilling programs enables displaced workers to transition into robot fleet supervision, calibration, and exception handling.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 段落内主语瘦身与尾重平衡（Subject Compression & End-Weight）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 在多句段落中，严禁出现超过 10–12 个单词的臃肿主语从句或连环 of 短语作主语（头重脚轻）。把已知的短核心名词放在主语位置（≤6 词），将复杂的条件、机制和结果顺延到谓语动词之后的宾语或状语从句中。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Bad: [The phenomenon that A with B under C fails to D] is common. -> Good: [Short Subject A] frequently fails to [Verb D] when [Condition B and C occur].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 受中文“……的现象/问题/事实表明……”影响，写出 The fact that... is... 或 The problem of the degradation of... is... 的畸形句。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: The phenomenon that autoregressive language models hallucinate unverified citations when prompted with out-of-distribution academic queries is a serious obstacle.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Autoregressive language models frequently hallucinate unverified citations when prompted with out-of-distribution academic queries, posing a serious obstacle to automated literature review.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 主语从 17 个词压缩为 3 个词（Autoregressive language models），强动词 hallucinate 提前，句尾用分词结果状语自然收束。

focal_logic_rules.category: Rebuttal & Peer Review (审稿回复逻辑)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 黄金四步：致谢认同 -> 结论前置 -> 新增证据/表格 -> 修订位置锚定
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 回复审稿人尖锐质疑时，绝不能情绪化辩解或绕圈子。第一句简短感谢并重申问题核心；第二句直接给出明确结论（Direct Answer）；第三至四句呈上新增实验数据或理论澄清（New Empirical Evidence）；末句指明已在修订稿哪一节哪一表更新。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: We thank Reviewer X for raising this insightful question regarding [Topic]. [Direct Answer: Our method maintains 84% success even under 30% occlusion]. Specifically, our new ablation in Table R1 shows that [Data]. We have incorporated this analysis into Section 4.3 (highlighted in blue).
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 用大段文字教育审稿人“你没看懂我们的论文”，或者只口头承诺“我们以后会做实验”而不给真实数据。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: You misunderstood our paper. We already explained this in Section 3. Our model is actually very robust to noise.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: We thank the reviewer for highlighting the question of sensor noise robustness. To verify performance under severe corruption, we evaluated our policy under Gaussian observation noise ($\sigma \in [0.05, 0.20]$). As shown in Table R2 below, our model degrades by only 3.2% at $\sigma=0.20$, compared with a 21.5% drop for the Diffusion Policy baseline. We have added these results to Appendix D.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 礼貌专业，直接用新增噪声区间实验数据（3.2% vs. 21.5% 跌幅对比）让审稿人心服口服。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想在 Methodology 开篇（Section 3.1 Problem Formulation），严谨、简洁地定义输入张量、输出目标、约束条件与优化目标。

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L011 段落内主语瘦身与尾重平衡（Subject Compression & End-Weight））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 全是碎片化的幼稚简单句（The input is X. X has...），缺乏数学严谨性与核心科学问题界定。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

Given an binary observation mask $\mathbf{M} \in \{0, 1\}^{L \times C}$ indicating irregular sensor dropouts, our objective is to learn a generative mapping $p_\theta(\mathbf{Y}_{L+1:L+H} \mid \mathbf{X}_{1:L} \odot \mathbf{M})$ over future horizon $H$. Crucially, unlike standard settings that assume time-invariant marginal distributions, we explicitly account for non-stationary regime shifts where $\mathbb{E}[x_t]$ and $\text{Cov}(x_t)$ evolve continuously between the lookback and forecasting windows.

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S1 [任务总体形式化 Task Definition]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: Consider a multivariate time series $\mathbf{X}_{1:L} = [x_1, \dots, x_L]^\top \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$ recording $C$ correlated sensors over lookback horizon $L$.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S1 [任务总体形式化 Task Definition]：Consider a [System/Dataset] observed over a lookback window of length $L$, denoted as $\mathbf{X} = [x_1, \dots, x_L] \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$, where $C$ represents [Meaning]. | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S2 [补充条件或模态输入 Auxiliary/Condition Inputs]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: Given an binary observation mask $\mathbf{M} \in \{0, 1\}^{L \times C}$ indicating irregular sensor dropouts, our objective is to learn a generative mapping $p_\theta(\mathbf{Y}_{L+1:L+H} \mid \mathbf{X}_{1:L} \odot \mathbf{M})$ over future horizon $H$.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S2 [补充条件或模态输入 Auxiliary/Condition Inputs]：At each step $t$, the system also receives [Condition/Observation] $z_t \in \mathcal{Z}$ under [Noise/Missingness/Dynamic Regime]. | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: Crucially, unlike standard settings that assume time-invariant marginal distributions, we explicitly account for non-stationary regime shifts where $\mathbb{E}[x_t]$ and $\text{Cov}(x_t)$ evolve continuously between the lookback and forecasting windows.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S3 [预测/控制目标 Objective]：Our goal is to learn a parameterized mapping $f_\theta(\cdot)$ that predicts future states $\hat{\mathbf{Y}} \in \mathbb{R}^{H \times C}$ over horizon $H$ (or action trajectory $a_{t:t+K}$). | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: Academic Tech Talk & Conference Oral Delivery
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: The reading says that replacing all delivery trucks with autonomous drones will save energy. The professor disagrees. She says drones use a lot of battery to stay in the air and can only carry one package at a time.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L001 旧信息在前、新信息在后原则（Given-to-New Principle））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 句式碎片化（The reading says... The professor disagrees. She says...），缺乏紧凑的逻辑因果嵌套。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: The reading passage contends that replacing urban delivery vans with autonomous quadcopter drones will substantially reduce last-mile transportation energy consumption, citing the lighter weight of aerial vehicles. The lecturer directly challenges this premise by examining energy efficiency per kilogram of delivered freight. Specifically, she points out that unlike ground vehicles supported passively by road surfaces, multi-rotor drones must expend continuous battery power simply to counteract gravity and headwinds while carrying only a single parcel per trip. Consequently, servicing a dense apartment block via individual drone flights consumes nearly three times more energy per package than a single consolidated van route.

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: The reading passage contends that replacing urban delivery vans with autonomous quadcopter drones will substantially reduce last-mile transportation energy consumption, citing the lighter weight of aerial vehicles.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]：The reading passage contends that [Claim A], arguing that [Reading's Supporting Mechanism]. | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: The lecturer directly challenges this premise by examining energy efficiency per kilogram of delivered freight.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]：The lecturer directly challenges this assertion by pointing out that [Core Flaw / Neglected Factor in Reading's Premise]. | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: Specifically, she points out that unlike ground vehicles supported passively by road surfaces, multi-rotor drones must expend continuous battery power simply to counteract gravity and headwinds while carrying only a single parcel per trip.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit]. | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: Consequently, servicing a dense apartment block via individual drone flights consumes nearly three times more energy per package than a single consolidated van route.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S4 [结论锁定 Refutation Closure]：Consequently, rather than achieving [Reading's Goal], the proposed measure actually exacerbates [Negative Outcome]. | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: CET-6 & IELTS Task 2 Technology & Society Essay
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想作为 Introduction 第一段：说明多变量时间序列预测或具身智能控制在实际工业系统中的关键作用，以及高可靠性的刚需。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: In the rapidly developing modern world, time series forecasting plays a pivotal role in many fields. The fact that industrial sensors often have noise and distribution changes makes forecasting very hard and bad for decision making.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L019 顶会 Rebuttal 黄金四步：致谢认同 -> 结论前置 -> 新增证据/表格 -> 修订位置锚定）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: ① 首句 AI 套话（In the rapidly developing... plays a pivotal role）；② 第二句严重头重脚轻（The fact that... 11词从句作主语）且用词口语化（very hard and bad）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Multivariate time series forecasting underpins safety-critical scheduling across smart power grids, cloud clusters, and automated manufacturing. In these operational settings, control systems rely on multi-horizon predictions to balance supply fluctuations and prevent cascading overload. However, field sensors routinely operate under abrupt regime shifts, irregular sampling intervals, and high-frequency measurement noise. Failing to accommodate such non-stationary disturbances degrades long-range forecast reliability and triggers costly control oscillations.

sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: Multivariate time series forecasting underpins safety-critical scheduling across smart power grids, cloud clusters, and automated manufacturing.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S1 [任务锚定 Topic Anchor]：直接用紧凑主谓宾点明研究对象及其在真实系统中的核心功能（≤16词，禁用 In the era of AI）。 | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S2 [应用场景展开 Concrete Scenarios]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: In these operational settings, control systems rely on multi-horizon predictions to balance supply fluctuations and prevent cascading overload.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S2 [应用场景展开 Concrete Scenarios]：列举 2–3 个具体工程场景（如电网负荷调度、灵巧机械手装配）及其决策依赖。 | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S3 [苛刻工况约束 Operational Bottleneck]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: However, field sensors routinely operate under abrupt regime shifts, irregular sampling intervals, and high-frequency measurement noise.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S3 [苛刻工况约束 Operational Bottleneck]：指出真实部署环境下不可避免的物理/统计挑战（如非平稳漂移、传感器缺失、毫秒级延迟约束）。 | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。

sentence_constituent_comparison.role_and_move: S4 [研究必要性收束 Imperative Hook]
sentence_constituent_comparison.sentence_en: Failing to accommodate such non-stationary disturbances degrades long-range forecast reliability and triggers costly control oscillations.
sentence_constituent_comparison.constituent_and_flow_note_zh: 对应步骤：S4 [研究必要性收束 Imperative Hook]：点明若无法克服上述约束会造成什么具体系统后果，自然引出下一段对现有方法的审视。 | 句首锚定旧信息/逻辑视角，主干动词紧跟主语，复杂修饰置于宾语之后（符合尾重原则 L011 与旧新信息流 L001）。
